nodes.label: Post-Merge State

sub_graphs.title: Bellatrix: Execution Payload Validation
sub_graphs.description: Models the validation pipeline for execution payloads in process_execution_payload()

nodes.label: Execution Payload Received
nodes.description: A BeaconBlock with ExecutionPayload has been received for processing

nodes.label: Validate Parent Hash Consistency
nodes.description: Check execution_payload.parent_hash matches state.latest_execution_payload_header.block_hash

nodes.label: Validate RANDAO Mix
nodes.description: Check execution_payload.prev_randao matches get_randao_mix(state, get_current_epoch(state))

nodes.label: Validate Timestamp
nodes.description: Check execution_payload.timestamp matches compute_timestamp_at_slot(state, state.slot)

nodes.label: Validate No Empty Transactions
nodes.description: Ensure no transaction in the payload is an empty byte string

nodes.label: Verify Block Hash via Engine
nodes.description: Call execution_engine.is_valid_block_hash(payload) to verify block hash computation

nodes.label: Notify Execution Engine
nodes.description: Call execution_engine.notify_new_payload(payload) for full execution validation

nodes.label: Execution Payload Valid
nodes.description: All validation checks passed; payload header stored in state

nodes.label: Execution Payload Invalid
nodes.description: One or more validation checks failed; block is rejected

edges.label: No empty transactions; verify block hash

ambiguities.text: The ordering constraint 'execution payload processing occurs before RANDAO processing' has security implications that are not elaborated
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume this ordering prevents the execution payload from observing the current block's RANDAO reveal, which could be exploited for MEV or randomness manipulation.

ambiguities.text: TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY transition logic details (how PoW chain difficulty is verified) are not fully specified in this document
ambiguities.resolution_strategy: Assume the execution engine is responsible for verifying terminal total difficulty has been reached on the PoW chain before accepting the merge transition block.

implicit_assumptions.description: The execution engine (Geth, Nethermind, etc.) correctly implements notify_new_payload and is_valid_block_hash
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A buggy execution engine could accept invalid payloads, leading to consensus failures or state corruption

implicit_assumptions.description: The communication channel between consensus and execution layers (Engine API) is local and trusted
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: A MITM attack on the Engine API could cause the consensus layer to accept forged execution validation results

implicit_assumptions.description: An attacker cannot manipulate TERMINAL_TOTAL_DIFFICULTY to trigger a premature merge
implicit_assumptions.impact_if_false: Premature merge could occur on a PoW chain with insufficient security, allowing chain reorganization attacks
